answer_1.quote: We collect a dataset of movie synopses, on which we conduct a wide range of human and automated annotations... to contrast LLM and human storytelling and to probe LLM narrative structure comprehension.
datasets: Movie synopsis dataset (819 human + 819 GPT-4 generated)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate turning point identification using accuracy against expert annotations... Arousal and valence are quantified using the NRC-VAD lexicon... Win‑rate percentages are reported for suspense, emotion provocation, and overall preference.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 16 annotators... We annotate Turning Point and Story Arc... We rank three randomly shuffled narratives in terms of suspense, emotion provocation, and overall preference.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare paired machine‑generated stories (Outline‑Only vs. Arc‑Enhanced) and rank them on suspense, emotion provocation, and overall preference.
